behavior: `openChange` reports a close only for an open menu. When a controlled root does not apply an open by hover, the menu stays closed, and a pointer that leaves the trigger reports nothing. A listener thus gets no close of a menu that it did not open. `details.cancel()` declines an open in both libraries. Base UI reports a close with the reason `trigger-hover` then, because its store does not know if the parent applies the open later.
